triple_reward.observed: Main and daily: one failure advances attempt 0 to 2; session next sequence advances to 3 then rewinds to 2; following locate returns sequence_collision.

independent_session.observed: Five failing checks cover stale cursor rollback, following actions/retries and exhausted sequence sentinel.

decisions: One local pending-context queue scoped to the page generation and failed attempt; process only earned/requested intents, stop after success, and cancel on lifecycle invalidation.
Update active attempt, lives and completion state before presentation callbacks. Preserve each failed-commit retry opportunity; report only the final failure when valid intents are exhausted.
Keep original receipt results; session cursor monotonicity is not a promise that all business operations are serialized.
Use business lifecycle validity for daily revives without changing visibility guards for input or animations.
No new generic queue platform, ad-service API, storage format, SDK bridge or content transport changes.

prior_specialized_verification_not_rerun.scope: Independent UI, Python tooling, simulated release and signed HTTP/PCK/Spine/publication suites were not rerun. Their implementations are unchanged. Current full product integration and independent product business suites were rerun.

limits: Tests control synchronous notifications; native SDK callback frequency/order still requires actual bridge integration.
In-memory retry intents are not cross-process receipts when persistent storage continues failing.
Native bridge, mobile export/touch/background behavior, production CDN/TLS and visual acceptance remain external tasks.
Shutdown resource warnings remain recorded separately and are not proof of sustained leaks or of leak absence.
